semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Grapheal specializes in flexible graphene films and sensors, which can have applications in semiconductor devices, particularly in sensing technologies.
summary: Grapheal is a technology company that focuses on the development of flexible graphene films and battery-free sensors, leveraging its expertise in graphene synthesis and data analysis. The company aims to promote sustainable solutions in environmental, renewable energy, and healthcare sectors, contributing to reduced manufacturing costs and carbon footprints.
capabilities: Synthesis of high-quality, low-cost monolayer graphene

regional_presence.France: Grapheal is based in Grenoble, France, where it originated as a spin-off from the CNRS Néel Institute.
